blocker.command: pr-repair ingest-review --event-path <real GitHub pull_request_review event> --event-name pull_request_review
blocker.error: requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 403 Client Error: Forbidden for url: https://api.github.com/graphql
blocker.why: A REAL review event was assembled from live API data (Quantum-L9/l9-ci-core PR #148, review 5123102833, 2 inline comments, head 841f2dd9e0db) via the sanctioned gh api REST transport. pr-repair's own ingest path calls GitHub GraphQL, which this session gateway refuses with 403 - the same SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED_GRAPHQL condition the governance publish path reports.
blocker.classification: unavailable external system / surface restriction - the Layer 2 contract's named condition for partial

pr_repair_push_disabled_by_default.evidence: config.py:36 allow_push default False; :125 allow_push=os.getenv('PR_FIX_ALLOW_PUSH','0')=='1'; :79-80 raises unless mode is repair_verify_and_push. Push therefore requires BOTH an explicit env opt-in AND an explicit mode - it cannot be reached by default.
